notes.title: Collab Release: CryptoNinja Sakuya × NINPCHI!
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="1oTP6YsSYbU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We’ve launched a special collaboration event with the TV anime [i]“Shinobanai! CryptoNinja Sakuya”[/i] starting at 8:00 PM (JST) on Monday, July 7, 2025.[/p][p][/p][p]The anime’s third season ([i]“Shinobanai! CryptoNinja Sakuya: Volume 3”[/i]) also premieres on the same day on TOKYO MX. To celebrate the occasion, [i]NINPCHI! CRYPTONINJA PETIT[/i] is featuring an exclusive in-game event that brings the anime’s unique world into the game![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]The event is available now in [url="https://www.cryptofantasy.net/ninjapetit/"]the browser version (alpha) of NINPCHI! CRYPTONINJA PETIT.[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]In this special collaboration, characters from the anime appear as brand-new playable characters in the game.
New stages and enemy characters inspired by the show have also been added.[/p][p]Fans of the series will recognize familiar elements throughout, letting you enjoy the world of the anime in [i]NINPCHI![/i]’s charming pixel art style.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381402/d932d3bbeec860e746b1d0039d7a4b38058d9130.png"][/img][/p][p]The characters’ appearances, attack effects, and in-game animations are filled with playful touches and clever references to the anime.[/p][p][/p][p]Fans will find plenty of fun surprises that are sure to bring a smile to their faces.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381402/657b5805b3ee6ba53d6c54c7207be8626cafbba0.png"][/img][/p][h3]TV Anime [i]“Shinobanai! notes.title: Demo ver1.6.0 Update
notes.content:
In order to provide a comfortable playing environment for more players, we have implemented a localization update.

[h1]■Contents of the update[/h1]

・English support for in-game text .
・Critical bug fixes
・Fixed a critical bug.
・Other minor bug fixes

This update makes the in-game text more natural and easier to understand.
We will continue to make improvements to provide a better game experience for everyone.
